name: Mento Colombian Peso
oneLiner: COPm is Mento's Colombian peso stablecoin on Celo, issued and retired through the legacy USDm FX Broker pool against the shared Mento Reserve.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: current issuer configuration classifies this currency as reserve-backed, not USDm locked in a borrower-specific CDP.
pegMechanism: COPm is issued and retired through Mento V2's oracle-priced USDm/COPm Broker/BiPoolManager pool. USDm-to-COPm swaps burn incoming USDm and mint the FX token; reverse swaps burn the FX token and mint USDm, subject to the configured oracle, spread, trading limits, and breaker checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: At Celo block 78986505, COPm token 0x8a567e2ae79ca692bd748ab832081c45de4041ea is bound to the Broker's USDm/COPm pool. Its nonzero reverse quote, reserve stable-asset membership and deployed mint/burn code establish a limited operational shared-reserve claim, subject to oracle and trading-limit checks. The pinned explicit backing configuration and MGP-18 confirm reserve backing rather than CDP ownership. Fiat legal priority, whole-pool reconciliation and default recovery remain unestablished.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so COPm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
